purpose: Teach: 前掲/ケ月/バラエティー/実費/従前/学士/専従/枠内

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、前掲の方針を改めて確認しろ
lines.en: I want this company's existing policy reviewed and reconfirmed across all teams.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Measured pacing. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Pause before the directive. No warmth, no urgency—just the weight of expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトは三ケ月で完了予定です
lines.en: Understood. The project is on track for completion in three months.
lines.style: Alert, focused. Direct eye contact. Clipped delivery—professional without rigidity. A small nod of assurance embedded in the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品ラインのバラエティーを増やせ
lines.en: We need to expand the product line. More variety in what we're offering.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly. Firm, but not harsh. The second sentence feels like an explanation, not a repeat. Steady breath. Expectation is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への実費請求書を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared the detailed cost invoices for the clients.
lines.style: Straightforward, efficient. No hesitation. Words land crisp. The tone says: task identified, task completed. Ready for the next one.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、従前のお取引先を大事にしろ
lines.en: And keep our long-standing partners close. Don't let those relationships slip.
lines.style: Quieter than before—almost personal conviction beneath the directive. Slight lean-in, as if speaking to Kenji's judgment directly. Weight on 'long-standing.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。学士号取得者の採用枠を増やします
lines.en: Understood. I'm expanding the hiring pool for bachelor's degree holders.
lines.style: Assured, responsive. Light tempo. No defensiveness—just stating what's already in motion. Small professional confidence here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、専従の研究員を増員しろ
lines.en: We need dedicated research staff. Full-time positions. More of them.
lines.style: Slightly slower tempo on this one. Each element gets its own breath. Conviction underneath. This matters—the pacing shows it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。予算枠内での実施を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure it all stays within budget parameters.
lines.style: Calm, grounded finality. Measured pace. The tone closes the conversation gently—no rush, just competence. A small exhale at the end.
